meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行创建、预览和发布动画视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想用简单的命令制作和分享动画视频。
copy.tagline_en: Create, preview, and publish animated videos with a command-line tool.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to create and share animated videos using simple commands.

howto.what: Claude 会用 HyperFrames 命令行工具完成视频动画项目:初始化项目、查找/添加动画原语、编写合成,用 lint、check 检查,预览、渲染并验证输出;也用它诊断构建或渲染失败,覆盖本地、HeyGen 云、AWS Lambda、Google Cloud Run 渲染。
howto.when: 当你要求创建或编辑 HyperFrames 视频项目、执行渲染,或诊断构建/渲染失败时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 HyperFrames 初始化一个项目
say.note: 会执行 init 并搭建项目骨架

say.text: 运行 hyperframes check 检查项目
say.note: 会先跑 lint 再打开浏览器审计

say.text: 用高质量渲染成 out.mp4 并验证
say.note: 渲染前需确认已获最终批准

howto.what_en: Claude uses the HyperFrames CLI for video/motion projects: scaffold, find/add motion primitives, author compositions, run lint/check, preview, render, verify output, and diagnose build or render failures. Covers local, HeyGen cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to create or edit a HyperFrames project, render a video, or diagnose build/render failures.

say_en.text: Set up a new HyperFrames project for me.
say_en.note: Runs init and scaffolds the project.

say_en.text: Run hyperframes check on this project.
say_en.note: Runs lint first, then audits in the browser.

say_en.text: Render this with high quality to out.mp4 and verify.
